mapper.select: select bi.bottling_id, bi.batch_id, e.region_id, r.ancestors, r.region_name, e.enterprise_name, p.product_name, b.batch_no, vp.plot_name, vp.gps_coordinates, w.workshop_name, b.entry_workshop_time, c.container_code as source_container_code, c.container_type as source_container_type, c.location_detail as source_location_detail, bi.bottling_date, bi.bottle_spec, bi.cap_code, bi.qr_code_url, qr.inspection_date, qr.inspector, qr.is_qualified from trace_bottling_info bi left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = bi.batch_id left join trace_product p on p.product_id = b.product_id left join trace_vineyard_plot vp on vp.plot_id = b.plot_id left join trace_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = vp.enterprise_id left join trace_region r on r.region_id = e.region_id left join trace_workshop w on w.workshop_id = b.workshop_id left join trace_container c on c.container_id = bi.source_container_id left join trace_quality_report qr on qr.report_id = ( select q.report_id from trace_quality_report q where q.batch_id = b.batch_id and q.del_flag = '0' order by q.inspection_date desc, q.report_id desc limit 1 ) where bi.del_flag = '0' and bi.trace_code_prefix = #{traceCodePrefix} and #{traceCodeSerial} between bi.trace_code_start and bi.trace_code_end limit 1

select wb.bill_id, wb.bill_type, wb.bill_no, wb.operate_time, d.quantity, d.start_trace_code, d.end_trace_code, l.carrier, l.tracking_no, l.consignee, l.destination, l.ship_date from trace_warehouse_bill_detail d left join trace_warehouse_bill wb on wb.bill_id = d.bill_id and wb.del_flag = '0' left join trace_logistics l on l.out_bill_id = wb.bill_id and l.del_flag = '0' where d.bottling_id = #{bottlingId} and d.del_flag = '0' order by wb.operate_time asc, d.detail_id asc
